title: Fair multilingual vandalism detection system for Wikipedia

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring group fairness using Disparate Impact Ratio (DIR) and calculating the difference in Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) scores between privileged (registered) and unprivileged (anonymous) users.
Comparing model performance (AUC scores) across 47 different Wikipedia languages to evaluate disparities in vandalism detection accuracy and accessibility for different language communities.
